title: Tiny Coding Agent
tagline: Build a bounded coding loop that applies exact patches to a disposable workspace and runs its real tests through an allowlisted tool contract.
summary: Build a bounded coding loop that applies exact patches to a disposable workspace and runs its real tests through an allowlisted tool contract.
youWillBuild: A repair agent that exposes the patch/test evidence trail and refuses unsupported success claims.
usefulFor: A repair agent that exposes the patch/test evidence trail and refuses unsupported success claims.
The CLI copies a trusted Python workspace to a new destination, then runs its tests as local code.

languageWhy.Python: The standard library makes parsing, scoring, and failure handling visible without hiding the mechanism behind a framework.

skills: Confine file tools to a workspace
Run real tests through one allowed command
Stop the coding loop on evidence or budget

stages.title: Confine file tools to a workspace
stages.summary: Resolve existing relative file paths under a workspace and reject traversal, absolute paths, symlink escapes, and nonfiles.
stages.languageWhy: Use explicit data structures and deterministic standard-library operations.

stages.title: Apply exact patches with preconditions
stages.summary: Replace one exact occurrence and preserve the file on missing or ambiguous matches.
stages.languageWhy: Use explicit data structures and deterministic standard-library operations.

stages.title: Run real tests through one allowed command
stages.summary: Run unittest discovery in the workspace and report passed, tests, output, and a terminal state.
stages.languageWhy: Use explicit data structures and deterministic standard-library operations.

stages.title: Stop the coding loop on evidence or budget
stages.summary: Consume patch and test actions, record results, and return completed, failed, or budget_exhausted.
stages.languageWhy: Use explicit data structures and deterministic standard-library operations.
